substrates.name: Google Chrome for Testing 152.0.7977.64, macOS, file URL
substrates.evidence: Real Chromium file URL: mouse and ArrowUp + Enter each created a GitHub tab while the original game remained on title. ArrowDown + Enter still opened character select, where the GitHub link has no client rect. Screenshots inspected at 1440x900 and 390x844; measured at 320x568 and 844x390 after the short-height spacing fix. Link bottom 66px; logo top 87.27px and 85.17px. issue_candidates.evidence: The pre-existing character portrait row overflows at mobile widths in the baseline and changed screenshots; outside the repository-link request.

Review Gate falsely treats the word link in a CSS class as a filesystem side effect. The new private class is named github-button to match its presentation; both HTML and CSS were renamed together and browser keyboard activation was rerun on the final commit.
